obec.title: Municipality
obec.description: Name or code (names repeat; the run tells you the codes if ambiguous)

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in WGS84; only notices whose parcels could be resolved match

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Any of them in title or description, diacritics ignored, e.g. "fotovoltaick", "bytový dům"

onlyNew.title: Only new since the last run
onlyNew.description: For daily schedules: returns only notices not returned by earlier runs (state kept in the named key-value store czech-building-notices-state).

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Use a different key per schedule when you run several schedules with different filters.

includeExpired.title: Include expired notices
includeExpired.description: Past their 'relevant until' date; only metadata and link are returned.

inProtectedArea.title: Only in protected areas
inProtectedArea.description: Only notices with a parcel in a CHKO, national park, Natura 2000 site or nature reserve.

resolveParcels.title: Resolve parcels in RÚIAN
resolveParcels.description: Area, land type and WGS84 position of parcels named in the notice.

withContext.title: Add protected and mining areas
withContext.description: CHKO and zone, national park, Natura 2000 and mining areas at up to 3 parcels per notice (extra RÚIAN requests).

maxParcelLookups.title: Max RÚIAN lookups
maxParcelLookups.description: Upper bound of parcel lookups in RÚIAN for the whole run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy for unreachable boards
proxyConfiguration.description: Many municipal sites refuse connections from foreign data-centre IPs. With Apify Proxy on, boards that do not connect are retried through a Czech exit (only those, so traffic stays small).

limit.title: Max notices
limit.description: You pay per notice in the dataset.
